description: Comprehensive reasoning vault for Cartesian coordinate system, plotting points, quadrants, intercepts, horizontal and vertical lines, slope calculation, slope-intercept form, parallel and perpendicular slopes, and coordinate modeling.

archetypes.name: Cartesian Coordinate Plane and Point Identification
archetypes.coreConcept: Locate ordered pairs (x, y) relative to origin and determine coordinate quadrants based on signs of abscissa and ordinate.
archetypes.mentalModel: Two orthogonal number lines intersecting at origin (0, 0).

archetypes.name: Finding X- and Y-Intercepts of Linear Graphs
archetypes.coreConcept: Determine where a line crosses coordinate axes by setting y = 0 for x-intercept and x = 0 for y-intercept.
archetypes.mentalModel: Boundary collision points of a linear trajectory with coordinate axes.

archetypes.name: Equations of Horizontal and Vertical Lines
archetypes.coreConcept: Horizontal lines have equation y = c and zero slope; vertical lines have equation x = c and undefined slope.
archetypes.mentalModel: Fixed altitude trajectories versus plumb line vertical fences.
archetypes.governingRelation: y = c \implies m = 0 \land x = c \implies m \text{ undefined}

archetypes.name: Calculating Slope from Two Coordinate Points
archetypes.coreConcept: Slope measures rate of vertical change per unit horizontal change: m = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1).
archetypes.mentalModel: Steepness ratio of vertical rise to horizontal run.

archetypes.name: Slope-Intercept Form y = mx + b
archetypes.coreConcept: Identify rate of change m and initial baseline offset b from linear equation y = mx + b.
archetypes.mentalModel: Starting elevation plus continuous steady-state climb rate.

archetypes.name: Parallel Lines and Slope Equality Invariant
archetypes.coreConcept: Two non-vertical lines are parallel if and only if they have equal slopes: m1 = m2.
archetypes.mentalModel: Equidistant trajectories maintaining constant separation indefinitely.

archetypes.name: Midpoint Coordinates of Line Segments
archetypes.coreConcept: The midpoint coordinate is the arithmetic mean of endpoint coordinates: ((x1 + x2)/2, (y1 + y2)/2).
archetypes.mentalModel: Equilibrium center of mass of two coordinate endpoints.

archetypes.name: Perpendicular Lines and Orthogonal Slopes
archetypes.coreConcept: Two non-vertical lines are perpendicular if and only if their slopes multiply to -1: m1 * m2 = -1.
archetypes.mentalModel: Quarter-turn rotation (90 degrees) flipping and inverting rise and run.

archetypes.name: Applied Linear Cost Modeling and Slope Interpretation
archetypes.coreConcept: Interpret the physical meaning of slope as marginal cost and y-intercept as fixed operational overhead in empirical cost models.
archetypes.mentalModel: Linear fiscal trajectory composed of fixed base plus variable activity cost.
archetypes.governingRelation: C(x) = mx + b \implies m = \frac{\Delta C}{\Delta x}

archetypes.name: Cartesian Coordinate Area and Dimension Synthesis
archetypes.coreConcept: Synthesize coordinate differences to determine dimensional lengths and calculate enclosed polygonal area on a coordinate grid.
archetypes.mentalModel: Mapping Cartesian boundary deltas into planar surface area.
